source.gazette_issue: Extraordinary No. 2962, Part II-Sec 3(ii); masthead Monday 15 Jun 2026; e-published 19 Jun 2026 (digitally signed 19 Jun 2026 22:31 IST)
source.gazette_text_basis: English operative text extracted from the PDF text layer (Hindi not decoded). Whitespace and line-break hyphenation normalised; wording otherwise verbatim.
source.operative_template: in exercise of powers conferred by section 26A of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 (23 of 1940), the Central Government ... hereby prohibits the manufacture, sale or distribution of the fixed dose combination of {composition} for human use, with immediate effect.
source.legal_scope: Each notice prohibits the manufacture, sale or distribution of one specific fixed-dose combination for human use. Not limited by strength, dosage form, route, salt or region. It does not cover import, possession, use or prescribing, and makes no finding about any product, brand or seller. Court search non-exhaustive.
source.effective_date_note: 'With immediate effect' runs from Gazette publication: masthead 15 Jun 2026 vs e-publication 19 Jun 2026 is unresolved. Irrelevant for captures made after 20 Jun 2026.
source.coverage: All 16 notices, S.O. 3068(E)-3083(E). F01 and F08-F16 are the ten combinations in the preregistered browser study. F02-F07 (aloe-based preparations) were added on 2026-10-11 from the same hash-pinned Gazette PDF and the PIB list; they are outside the preregistered study, were not part of the independent legal audit, and have no capture evidence yet. Deliberately not aliased: 'aloe vera' vs 'aloe extract', and 'vitamin e' vs 'alphatocopherol acetate' (the Gazette uses different names, and treating them as synonyms would be a legal inference). F07 lists an unspecified 'Herbal' component and can never match exactly.

Not searched: High Court case-status pages and cause lists, Supreme Court diary, eCourts/NJDG, paid databases, unindexed interim orders. This search is not exhaustive.
